messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick pass needed — uploaded launch blog draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-final. Can folks look for: 1) audience hooks (PM vs infra), 2) benchmark/claim language, 3) webinar CTA routing? Short replies pls :eyes:

devon (Product): Skimming. My rec: start with a 1-line PM hook, then an infra highlight box with numbers. Two CTA paths (PM/Infra) but one form with hidden segment is ideal.

ajay (Growth): Yep one form + hidden field. Use `?seg=pm` or `?seg=infra`. I'll route to lists: wf_pm_launch and wf_infra_launch. Tag: launch_q2_2026.

sam (Design): I'll make two hero variants and a small feature->buyer table for the post. Will also add a compact CTA that swaps by URL param. ETA 3h.

eli (Legal): Redline: use "up to" for numeric claims, explicitly name baseline ("standard A100 baseline"), include a benchmark link + short methodology, and add disclaimer: "Results may vary by workload and deployment."

maria (Marketing): Devon — suggest a safe benchmark sentence we can use that follows Eli's note?

devon (Product): Proposed: "Internal tests show up to 25% lower per-token latency vs standard A100 baseline and up to 30% lower per-request GPU cost (internal benchmark, May 2026; see methodology)."

eli (Legal): Fine as long as the benchmark doc link and methodology are included and we don't claim guaranteed savings. Add the one-line disclaimer under the claim.

sam (Design): Webinar seats = 250. Ajay — can the registration service switch CTA to "Join waitlist" at 230? Ill style the waitlist CTA orange.

ajay (Growth): Set seat_threshold=230, hard_cap=250. launch-bot will post counts at 200, 230, 250 and swap CMS copy when threshold reached.

launch-bot: Registration thresholds configured: threshold=230, capacity=250. Posting updates to #marketing at 200, 230, and full.

maria (Marketing): Awesome. I'll fold edits, add the benchmark link + methodology box + disclaimer, and re-upload the draft by EOD. If no blockers we hand to comms for copy lock tomorrow morning :rocket:
